typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFilecsv as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DataLoadErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorFile as string (),
	ErrorFilecsv as string (),
	ErrorListRecipients as string (),
	ErrorMessage as string (),
	ErrorPath as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	Market as string (),
	Marketcsv as string (),
	NonCalllistJobs as integer (),
	QuarantineFile as string (),
	QuarantineFilecsv as string (),
	QuarantinePath as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	TemplatePath as string (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		F1 as string,
		F2 as string,
		F3 as string,
		F4 as string,
		F5 as string,
		F6 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(Calllist = substring(toString(F5), toInteger(1), toInteger(3)),
		JobName_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F5), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		DispositionCode_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F6), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		MemberNum_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F4), toInteger(1), toInteger(30)),
		Associate_NonUnicode = substring(toString(F1), toInteger(1), toInteger(50)),
		Market = $Market) ~> AddCallListandMarket
AddCallListandMarket split(isNull(F4) == true(),F4 == 'MbrKey', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(F3NotSet,HeaderRow,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(EndDate = toDate(toString(F3, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		ScrubDate = toDate(toString(F2, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> ConvertScrubDate
ConvertScrubDate sink(input(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_END_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET = Market,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_END_DATE = EndDate,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME = JobName_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = Calllist,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE = ScrubDate,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE = Associate_NonUnicode,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE = DispositionCode_NonUnicode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
NonUnicodetoUnicode sink(input(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> NonCalllistErrorFile
NonUnicodetoUnicode sink(input(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> NonCalllistErrorFile
